Maria Chen: Heads-up: Pro customers in EU reporting 120-200ms extra p95 when routed to eu-west model variant; looking for routing rule changes before next deploy.
Kevin Patel: Saw spike in traces this morning, likely due to eu nodes overloaded after canary. Can you paste example routing config?
Maria Chen: Here are a couple traces: https://internal-traces/redwood/trace/0xabc123 — you can see queueing at the model worker.
Anjali Roy: We should prefer latency-based selection with a tier penalty. Idea: prefer same-region if p95 < 70ms, else failover to next preferred region if customer.allow_cross_region_fallback == true.
Sami Noor: We already have `region_affinity` but it's static. Suggest adding a dynamic `latency_probe` window (30s) + smoothed p95, and a cooldown to avoid flapping.
Sami Noor: Proposed config snippet:
```
routing_policy:
  type: latency_aware
  probe_window_s: 30
  p95_threshold_ms: 70
  cooldown_s: 120
  tier_penalties:
    free: 50
    pro: 10
    enterprise: 0
```
infra-bot: ALERT: eu-west autoscaler at 95% GPU utilization (last 5m)
Kevin Patel: Important: falling back to us-east increases token cost and can violate data residency. We need per-customer flags: `allow_fallback`, `fallback_targets`, and `data_residency_constraints`.
Maria Chen: Agreed. For Pro tier customers we can default `allow_fallback: true` but only when request.metadata.pii_tags == false. We'll add a config toggle per account.
Anjali Roy: Also need model-variant fallback mapping. If `gpt-opti-8q` isn't available in eu, fallback to `gpt-opti-8q-int8` or a compatible quantized variant that matches the API surface. Add kernel compatibility checks in runtime.
Kevin Patel: Also consider a cheap semantic-sanity check if returning from a different-region model (embedding cosine on small sample). Might be expensive at scale though.
Anjali Roy: We can do a lightweight signature check (token distribution / top-k overlap) during rollout and only enable full checks in canaries. Auto-rollback if cosine < 0.85 on canary set.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z for feature flag `routing-latency-v2`.
Oncall Ops: If we flip this flag, add a runbook step and a quota throttle (requests/sec cap) to prevent cascading cross-region spikes. Also ensure audit log entry when fallback is used.
Maria Chen: I'll draft the PR with the policy, runtime checks, and console tile for 'Routing policy preview' showing expected p95 and estimated cross-region traffic. @Kevin Patel can you handle infra autoscale + fallback-targets mapping? :thumbsup:
